hook.name: SlvrHook
hook.description: A hook for the SLVR/ETH pool that taxes exact-input swaps up to 2%: buys pay an ETH fee into a lottery jackpot pot and receive weighted tickets; sells pay a SLVR fee to in-range LP stakers. Optional hookData (address buyer, uint8 boost) enables ticket attribution and boost multipliers. Exact-output and partial fills revert.
